notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.content:
Online Simulator has received its first patch. The primary aim of this update is fixing bugs and working on some clues to balance the game.

A few changes I've made:
-Unzipper app is no longer broken. The interface is now visible.
-Easier clue to access the first round of archived messages.

Changes planned for future updates:
-Functional Steam achievements
-Additional settings in the settings menu
